blocks.name: immediate_generator
blocks.responsibility: Generate sign-extended I-, S-, B-, and J-type immediates and the zero-extended U-type immediate from the instruction word.
blocks.design_rationale: Centralizes immediate bit mapping so its correctness can be verified independently without adding sequential state or affecting the single-cycle datapath.

blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: Implement 32 32-bit integer registers with asynchronous reads, asynchronous active-high reset, hardwired-zero x0, and synchronous writes that ignore x0.
blocks.design_rationale: Isolates architectural state and its reset and x0 rules, making register behavior straightforward to verify independently.

blocks.name: execution_unit
blocks.responsibility: Execute RV32I integer register and immediate operations, AUIPC addition, RV32M multiply/divide/remainder operations, and branch comparisons. Return the arithmetic or logical result and whether the selected branch condition is true.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeps arithmetic, M-extension corner cases, and branch-condition logic in one independently testable combinational datapath block.

blocks.name: cpu
blocks.responsibility: Implement the specified single-cycle RV32IM CPU: expose the instruction and data buses, maintain and update the PC, instantiate the immediate generator, register file, and execution unit, decode instructions, select writeback data, and implement load extraction/sign extension and store controls. Select jump targets in JAL/JALR/branch priority, clear bit zero of JALR targets, and drive effective byte addresses and data widths as specified.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeps bus timing, instruction decode, PC control, and datapath integration at the required top-level boundary while allowing state, immediate generation, and execution to be verified as separate blocks.

notes: Use only ieee.std_logic_1164 and ieee.numeric_std. The top-level entity is cpu and its ports match the required contract exactly.
